title: On-Policy Residual Learning for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residual context is key to unlocking the speed-quality Pareto frontier of diffusion language models (DLMs) by carrying forward predictive distributions across denoising steps. Yet turning this seemingly simple mechanism into an effective learning paradigm is far from simple: there is no clear recipe for how residual context should be learned. We introduce ORL, a framework for on-policy residual learning in DLMs. Algorithmically, we identify that residual learning is inherently on-policy. ORL learns from model-induced residual trajectories on the fly and introduces an entropy-contraction objective that sharpens predictions as the model revisits its own predictions. System-wise, exact residual supervision requires capturing, retaining, and reprocessing many trajectory-dependent states. ORL co-designs the algorithm with asynchronous residual capture and transport, specialized block-diffusion attention, and packed compute-balanced training,

translated_title: 扩散语言模型的在策略残差学习
translated_abstract: 残差上下文是在去噪步骤间传递预测分布、从而解锁扩散语言模型（DLM）速度-质量帕累托前沿的关键。然而，将这一看似简单的机制转化为有效的学习范式并非易事：目前尚无明确的方案指导残差上下文应如何学习。我们提出了ORL，一个面向扩散语言模型在策略残差学习的框架。在算法层面，我们发现残差学习本质上是在策略的。ORL实时地从模型自身诱导的残差轨迹中学习，并引入了一个熵收缩目标，使模型在重新审视自身预测时逐渐锐化预测结果。在系统层面，精确的残差监督需要捕获、保留并重新处理大量依赖轨迹的状态。ORL将算法与系统协同设计：采用异步残差捕获与传输、专用的块扩散注意力机制，以及打包的计算均衡训练。
tldr: 该论文提出ORL框架，发现残差学习本质上是在策略的，通过熵收缩目标实时学习模型自身诱导的残差轨迹，并结合异步残差捕获、块扩散注意力等算法-系统协同设计，实现扩散语言模型速度与质量的高效平衡。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ORL, a framework showing that residual learning is inherently on-policy, which learns from model-induced residual trajectories via an entropy-contraction objective and co-designed systems (asynchronous residual capture, block-diffusion attention) to unlock the speed-quality Pareto frontier of diffusion language models.
